answer: What survives to the comet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the violet of a task receipt, and the signal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
